result.title: PRISM: Promoting Sampling Diversity of Large Language Models with Implicit Stochastic Modulation
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit mode collapse, where their output distribution concentrates on familiar semantic modes. When diversity disappears, repeated sampling becomes semantic repetition rather than discovery, making rare but stronger solutions unlikely to surface and leaving self-evolution and continual learning difficult to sustain. Most remedies intervene only at inference time, shaping sam- ples without making diversity a model capability. We propose PRISM, a training-time framework that internalizes diversity within the model. PRISM combines (i) submodular curation that pairs each prompt with diverse-yet-correct multi-teacher solutions, and (ii) stochastic embedding modulation, which turns special-token perturbations into implicit signals for sampling distinct outputs. A theoretical analysis establishes the stability of this mechanism. On WritingPrompts and BookMIA, PRISM moves the quality-diversity frontier outward, achieving the best generation quality in all model-benchmark settings while maintaining the strongest or near-strongest semantic diversity across two open-weight model families. It also improves sampling efficiency on math and code benchmarks. Beyond inference, PRISM yields a stronger foundation for reinforcement learning, sustaining diverse rollouts and mitigating the diversity collapse commonly observed during RL training.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PRISM 训练期框架：用子模函数筛选多样化且正确的多教师解答，并将特殊 token 扰动转为随机嵌入调制，使输出多样性内化为模型能力，在写作、数学、代码及 RL rollout 上缓解多样性崩塌。
AI.relevance_reason: 「以随机嵌入调制向内部表示注入扰动、并构造多样化正确轨迹」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中潜推理轨迹的探索多样性、RL rollout 同质化及轨迹监督设计。
